tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dkar chag du ma'i mchod brjod snyan ngag dang sbyar ba 'ga' zhig logs su bkod pa bzhugs/

oṃ bde legs su gyur cigalhan skyes bde chen ye shes chos sku dbyings dang ro gcig brtan g.yo kun son nam mkha' bzhin/ /zag med sgyu dra'i longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dpe gsal ldan dbang po'i gzhu 'am nyin byed bzhin/ /gdul bya'i mos mtshor sna tshogs sprul sku ther 'bum cig car mig 'phrul chu nang zla gzugs bzhin/ /ci yang 'char mdzad rigs kun khyab bdag zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang zhabs snying dbus dhu tir rtag rol zhing*/ /rgya chen tshogs gnyis zung 'brel grur zhugs byang chub spyod pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /brtson pa'i lung gis thabs shes dar bskul sku gsum nor bu'i gling phyin nas/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal brnyes 'gro la dam chos 'dod rgu'i dngos/ /kun nas stsol mdzad lha mi'i 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs pad mchod/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags dam chos ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin pa yis/ /rgyal bstan phyogs mthar sbel ba'i mdzad pa can/ /rgyal tshab mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /ces pa ni dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten chen po'i dkar chag gi mchod brjod logs su bris pa'o// //oṃ swa sti/ 'gro ba kun la kun nas rab tu brtse ba'i thugs mchog mchog tu rtag goms shing*/ /bskal bar rab dkar rab 'byams dge legs tshogs gnyis gnyis char nyams su bzhes nas kyang*/ /grangs med ji lta ji snyed chos rnams mngon gzigs gzigs pa'i ye shes mchog brnyes pa/ /ston pa lha yi lha khyod bdag sogs ma lus lus can kun gyi mgon skyabs phul/ /rab brtan brtson pa'i mgyogs 'gro'i shugs kyis spangs rtogs shar ri'i rtse nas 'phags/ /mdzad mchog 'od dkar 'phreng ba yis ni thub bstan kunda ci yang 'dzum/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi mun pa gtan sel byang chub spyod pa'i mkha' la rtsen/ /smra ba'i zla ba rgyal sras thu bo mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs la

'dud/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings rgya mtshor rtag rol zhing*/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i phud sgra drag tu 'byin/ /rtag chad lta ba'i tsha gdung sel mdzad pa/ /nā gā rdzu na klu yi dbang por 'dud/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i mkha' la rab 'phags te/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos padmo'i tshal brgya 'byed/ /rgyal bas lung bstan thogs med sku mched sogs/ /rgyal sras 'dzam gling rgyan rnams phyag gi yul/ /blo chen rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud gzhung bzang thogs pa med pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs sprul rgyal ba gnyis par rab tu grags/ /grags pa don ldan dam chos ma lus nges bar 'dzin pa chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun bla ma btsong kha pa khyod mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /theg mchog lha yi lam la rtag rgyu zhing*/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gos can mtha' dag kyang*/ /rab 'bar rigs pa'i zer gyis snang byed pa'i/ /sras kyi thu bo gnyis la'ang mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mang thos chu gter dbus su gnas bcas te/ /lung dang rigs pa'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ /yon tan rin chen gzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /bshes gnyen lhun po de yang rtag tu bsngags/ /mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i sa 'dzin dbang po'i rtser/ /thos bsam sa srung steng gnas rmongs pa'i mgor/ /rnam dpyod rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen lha dbang tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /thugs mchog zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir drag tu khraus pa'i skur/ /mngon bstan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /gus pas 'dud kyis 'dus ba'i sde 'di skyongs/ / zhes pa ni mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi dkar chag gi mchod brjod logs su phyung ba'o// //oṃ swa sti/ mkha' ltar dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings su dbyer med lhan skyes bde chen dang*/ /mkha' la shar ba'i dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rnam bkra'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /mkha' khyab brtan g.yo'i dkyil 'khor kun kyang chu zla ji bzhin yongs 'char ba/

/dpal ldan rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang de rgyal/ /rnam dag rnam dkar dge tshogs las 'khrungs mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku/ /rab snyan rab mang 'gro ba'i skad bzhin mthun par ston pa drug cu'i dbyangs/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas kun mngon sum gzigs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /lha yi lha mchog khams gsum bla ma shākya seṅges dge legs stsol/ /dri med mkhyen rab yangs pa'i mkha' la brtse ba'i chu 'dzin phung po 'khrigs/ /zab gsal gsung gi 'brug sgra'i dpal mdzes legs bshad char chen ci yang 'bebs/ /phan bde'i lo tog kun nas rgyas mdzad rgyal sras spyod pa'i zlos gar can/ /rgyal tshab mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs pad spyi bo'i gtsug gis bsten/ /rgyal ba'i yab gyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs gang rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus pa/ /rgyal kun dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin phyir rgyal sras gzugs kyi rnam rol zhes/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mgrin gcig rab bsngags rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus pa/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po btsong kha pa khyod rgyal ba nyid las lhag par nges/ /zhes pa ni rje'i gsung 'bum gser bris kyi dkar chag gi mchod brjod logs su bkod pa ste/ mjug tu/ khyad par thub bstan bstan pa'i snying po nges don don bzhin gsal mdzad pa/ /mdo rgyud kun mkhyen mkhyen rab dbang phyug ma lus lus can kun gyi skyabs/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul tshul bzhin 'dzin mdzad 'jam dpal dpal ldan bla ma mchog /gang de'i legs bshad bshad srol bzang po ji srid srid mthar rgyas gyur cig /zhes so// // na mo gu ru/ chos sku'i rang bzhin mkha' ltar rnam dag skye 'gag spros dang bral ba las/ /tshogs gnyis rlung gi shing rtas nyer drangs longs spyod rdzogs sku nyin mor byed/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i khams dang mos mtshor sbrul sku'i snang brnyan 'bum 'char ba/ /dpag las 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig zas gtsang sras pos dge legs stsol/

/rab 'byams zhing du rab 'byams rgyal ba'i drung*/ byang chub ched du byang chub spyod pa'i gar/ /grangs med 'gro la grangs med rab ston pa/ /mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus phyag 'tshal/ / rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam kun/ /kun nas 'grub phyir gsung rab grangs nges tshul/ /tshul bzhin 'grel mdzad shing rta chen po sogs/ / 'phags yul mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams spyi bos bsten/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshul gyis legs bzung nas/ /ji bzhin 'gro la gsal mdzad chos kyi rje/ /bshes gnyen rim par byon rnams phyag gi gnas/ /ring nas legs spyad mchod sbyin brgyas bskrun thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i rtser/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i sa srung la zhon 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rdo rje yis/ /log rtog lha min dpung tshogs kun bcom chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog bsgreng ba/ /skal ldan lha rnams kun gyi bla ma kun mkhyen btsong kha pa khyod rgyal/ /zhes pa ni jo bo'i lha khang gi dkar chag gi mchod brjod logs su bkar ba'o// //na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpag med legs tshogs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho brtson pa'i dpung gis bsrubs las 'khrungs/ /grangs med chos kun kun nas mngon gzigs mkhyen pa'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /dmigs med rab brtse brtse ba chen po'i bsil ba'i rlan gyis rtag brlan pa/ /mtshungs med rnam 'dren 'dren pa mchog gyur thub dbang smra ba'i zla bar 'dud/ /stobs bcu'i go 'phang ring nas mngon gyur kyang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug zol bsten zhing kun tu/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /rgyal tshab 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus nas/ /rab mang 'gro ba'i blo mun sel phyir du/ /rab byon brtan pa'i 'khor lo la 'gran pa/ /rab mchog rje btsun btsong kha pa khyod bsngags/

/gsung rab kun gyi drang nges ma lus pa/ /ji bzhin gzigs nas 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ /tshul bzhin 'doms pa'i gtam la dbang 'byor ba/ /bshes gnyen tshogs kyi bka' drin dran pas dad/ /ces pa ni dgon pa'i bla rabs kyi dkar chag gi mchod brjod logs su phyung ba'o// //na mo gu ru ma hā badzra dhā ra ye/ gcig min 'gro la gcig tu brtse ba'i zla med skyabs gcig kun gyi dpung gnyen gcig gyur cing*/ tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs sgrib gnyis kun sbyangs don gnyis mthar phyin chos gzugs sku gnyis rab brnyes nas/ /theg gsum 'gro la rnam gsum 'khor lo lan gsum bskor nas sku gsum go 'phang la 'god pa/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang tshad med bzhi rdzogs rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi mi 'jigs bzhi ldan de la 'dud/ /rgyal bas rab mdzes rin chen cod pan nyid kyi dbu la legs bcings te/ /rang gi rgyal tshab mchog tu dbang bskur sher phy-in rgya mtsho'i khong zab nas/ /sbas don yid bzhin rin chen nor blangs legs bshad rgyal mtshan rtse mo ru/ /mngon mchod skal ldan re ba yongs skong rgyal tshab mi pham mgon de rgyal/ /gang gi mkhyen pa'i skad cig gis kyang bgrang yas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /ji bzhin gzigs la mtshungs pa'i dper 'os 'jig rten 'di na gzhan med pas/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gsung dbyangs mgrin gcig khyod la mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhes/ /lan cig min par yang dang yang bsngags 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la 'dud/ / gzhung lugs gangs ri'i sul la gnas bcas legs bshad g.yu ral mchog gis mdzes/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i nga ro drag po sa chen 'di la cher bsgrags pas/ /rtag chad smra ba'i lag ldan snying 'gas rigs pa'i mche sder 'bar ba can/ /smra ba'i seṅge klu sgrub zla ba zhi ba lha yi zhabs la 'dud/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam rlung shugs kyis/ /gsung rab yangs pa'i mkhar 'phags rnam dpyod cha/

/yongs rdzogs thub bstan kunda rgyas mdzad pa/ /rgyal sras thogs med sku mched zhabs la 'dud/ /mgon khyod 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can la sogs lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung bas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab 'byams mkha' la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor thogs med cing*/ /gzhung lugs 'dab stong stong phrag dag kyang cig car nyid du gsal mdzad pa/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma ma rig mun sel rje btsun btsong kha pa khyod bsngags/ /nges pa'i don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nges don mdo sngags bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ /nges par bshes gnyen gar gyis rnam rol par/ /nges pa shugs drag thob las gzhan du ci/ / mgon de'i legs bshad mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun/ /kun nas thugs chud mkhas pa kun gyi rje/ /rje btsun bla ma nyid mtshungs rgyal ba'i sras/ /sras kyi thu bo gsum la'ang gus phyag 'tshal/ /ces pa ni rje'i gsung 'bum par ma'i dkar chag gi mchod brjod logs su phyung ba'o// //oṃ swa sti/ zab mo'i thabs kyis gnyis snang spros pa'i kun rtog ma lus dbyings thim srid pa'i mgyogs 'gro'i rgyu ba bcad/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag de bzhin nyid dang dbyer med ro gcig sgrib bral lhan skyes 'od gsal bde chen dang*/ /shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems rang bzhin dbang po'i gzhu ltar dwangs shing gsal ba dag pa'i sgyu lus kyi/ /bden gnyis mi phyed zung du 'jug pa'i sku can rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen de nyid bsngags/ /rab dkar legs tshogs tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'khrungs rab mdzes mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngoms gser ri'i sku/ /rab lhan tshangs dbyangs dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus rab zab zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gsung*/ /rab 'byams chos kun kun nas sgrib med ji bzhin rab gzigs gzigs pa rnam dag bla na med pa'i thugs/ /rab mnga' ma lus lus can kun la thar lam rab ston ston pa mchog de'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/

/thos bsam bsgom pa'i gru gzings legs bsdams brtson pa'i rlung gis lhag bsam dar chen rab bskul te/ / byang chub spyod pa'i chu gter chen por ring nas zhugs shing sdug kun na kra'i 'jigs las grol/ /gtan bde rnam par grol ba'i gling mchog tu son kun mkhyen nor bu'i dpal de rab brnyes kyang*/ /rgyal sras ded dpon spyod pa'i gar gyis 'gro ba'i re skong rgyal tshab 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /mtha' bral gzhung lugs zab mo'i mtshor zhugs rnam grol rin chen gtsug na 'dzin/ / legs bshad gdengs ka mchog gis nyer mdzes zab rgyas char chen ci yang 'bebs/ /'gro ba'i dge legs myu gu smin mdzad drang nges phud kyi sgra chen sgrogs/ /mkhas mang gdengs can kun gyi dbang po shing rta che gnyis rgyal gyur cig /gzhung lugs sa 'dzin mthon po'i spor gnas mang thos lag ldan dbang bo'i steng*/ /legs bshad khyaun la lta ba'i spobs mtho rnam dpyod rdo rje rtsa brgya gdengs/ /rgol ngan sbyin skyes dpung tshogs kun 'joms rigs pa'i spyan stong rnam par bgrad/ /skal ldan lha rnams yongs kyi bla ma 'phags yul mkhas pa'i tshogs kun bsngags/ /ring nas bgyis pa'i dge legs kyis bskrun lung rtogs rin chen bdun dang ldan/ /mtha' yas mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung kun legs par bshad pa'i gser 'khor ches/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i sa chen khyod la 'dod rgur spyod pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rje btsun btsong kha pa de rgyal/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung don padmo'i tshal/ /legs bshad 'od stong zer gyis rab phye nas/ /zab don ze'u 'bru rgod mdzad thams cad mkhyen/ /rgya tshab smra ba'i nyi ma byams mgon dngos/ /rnam dpyod lang tsho dar ba'i lus stobs rgyas/ /lung dang rigs pa'i mche sder rab tu 'bar/ /phas rgol glang po stong gi thod 'gems pa/ /smra ba'i seṅge mkhas grub dge legs dpal/

/blo bzang rgyal ba'i lung rtogs chos rnams kyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la sa steng 'dir/ /'gran pa'i zla bral paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen/ /nges par mkhas grub de las gzhan du ci/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab pha rol phyin pa'i don/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa ru/ /legs par bsdus nas ston mdzad dge ba'i bshes/ /lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi brjod bya'i gnad kun kyang*/ /ji bzhin rtogs nas nyams su len mdzad cing*/ /skal ldan 'gro la rab ston chos kyi rje/ /gsang sngags brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad legs sbyar gyi/ /skad du gnas las de nyid bod kyi brdar/ /legs par bsgyur nas gtan la 'bebs mdzad pa/ /lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin dran pas dad/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa mchog /rtag tu srung bar rtag tu legs par zhal bzhes shing*/ /chos bzhin sgrub rnams chos bzhin rab tu skyong mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung rnams kyis bstan dang de 'dzin kun skyongs shig /ces pa 'di ni bka' 'gyur dkar chag gi mchod brjaud logs su bris pa'o/ /dkar chag 'di rnams ni bshad sgrub ming can bdag gis bgyis pa yin kyang*/ 'dir de dag gi mchod brjaud tsam zhig logs su phyung ba'i bar gyi yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub po/ /maṅgalaṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ dkar chag du ma'i mchod brjod snyan ngag dang sbyar ba 'ga' zhig logs su bkod pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 302-- PAGE 301-- PAGE 293-
